## Change and supported hardware

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and exact models/variants supported.

## Validation

- [ ] Parser/policy tests and relevant build results included.
- [ ] Physical tests are distinguished from compile-only checks.
- [ ] BLE/API/release metadata and companion app changes are coordinated.
- [ ] Unknown or stale battery evidence is not presented as healthy.
- [ ] No ride data, NVS, motor settings, or BMS protections were erased/changed.
- [ ] Fixtures contain no private addresses, pairing secrets, or GPS routes.

## Contribution rights

- [ ] I identified third-party code and preserved its notices.
- [ ] I read the current licensing status in LICENSING.md.

Project licensing and contributor terms are undecided. Agree contribution
permissions with the maintainer before merging outside code; this technical
checklist does not adopt a license or create a new contributor agreement.
